findings.title: Potential StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when diffing strings with overlapping prefix and suffix
findings.body:
In `verifySafeHtml()`, `start` is incremented from the beginning while `value` and `sanitized` match, and `end` is incremented from the end independently without checking `start + end < value.length()` and `start + end < sanitized.length()`. When one string is formed by inserting or deleting repeated characters inside a run of identical characters (for example, `value = "

"` vs `sanitized = "

"`, or `value = "aaa"` vs `sanitized = "aa"`), `start + end` will exceed the shorter string's length, causing `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` (or the `value.substring` call) on line 111 to throw `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` instead of recording a validation message.

findings.title: `ANCHOR_PATTERN` matches any tag starting with `a`, such as `<abbr>`, `<article>`, or `<audio>`
findings.body: `ANCHOR_PATTERN` is defined as `Pattern.compile("</?a[^>]*>")`, which matches any HTML tag whose name begins with `a` (e.g. `<abbr>`, `<address>`, `<area>`, `<article>`, `<aside>`, `<audio>`), not just `<a>` tags. A disallowed tag like `<audio src=...>` or `<article>` will be treated as an anchor tag by `santizeAnchors` rather than being evaluated by the HTML sanitizer policy (or could even be stripped before sanitization if present in the English string). The pattern should require a word boundary or whitespace/`>` after `a`, e.g. `</?a(?:\s[^>]*)?>`.

findings.title: i18next message replaced with incompatible Java MessageFormat `choice` syntax in Account and Admin UI
findings.body: In `js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties` (line 188) and `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties` (line 3138), `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from i18next interpolation syntax (`Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).`) to Java `MessageFormat` syntax (`Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`). The Account UI and Admin UI are React/i18next applications that use `{{0}}` double-brace placeholders (like all other `error-*` keys in these files) and do not evaluate Java `ChoiceFormat` expressions, so placeholders and `{2,choice,...}` will be rendered literally to users in the UI.

findings.title: Lithuanian `totpStep1` / `loginTotpStep1` replaced with Italian translation
findings.body: In both `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties` (line 101) and `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties` (line 71), the Lithuanian translation was replaced with the Italian text `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` instead of Lithuanian.
